test_cases.name: stops_when_spec_not_approved
test_cases.input: Cập nhật spec .physarum/docs/specs/2026-11-01-auth-design.md, code lệch rồi (spec chưa approve)
assertions: Checks the spec's approval before any patch
Stops and points to /spec when the spec is not approved
Does NOT edit the spec file

test_cases.name: confirm_before_write
test_cases.input: Spec ghi callback lỗi trả 401, code đang trả 302 /?auth=<reason>. Ghi vào spec.
assertions: Announces `Using spec: <path>`
Gets the base commit from git log -- <spec-path> and runs git diff <base>..HEAD -- apps/
Drafts labeled hunks (MODIFIED/ADDED/REMOVED) in conversation and shows each hunk with why
Does NOT call Edit or Write on the spec before the user confirms the hunks
Writes only the hunk, NOT a rewrite of the whole file

test_cases.name: modified_keeps_old_scenario
test_cases.input: Patch §3 của spec: callback lỗi giờ redirect
assertions: MODIFIED hunk keeps the old scenario
Reads related intent, plan and ADR and checks both directions for contradiction
Rereads the spec after writing and scans new notes against old text

test_cases.name: ui_only_drift_not_patched
test_cases.input: Code đổi trigger 32px thay vì 24px và đổi copy nút. Cập nhật spec.
assertions: Lists the sizing and copy changes as `UI-only (không patch)` with a reason
Does NOT add them to the spec body

test_cases.name: undecided_behavior_stops_with_options
test_cases.input: Spec có endpoint /export nhưng code không có. Spec gợi ý xóa, cứ xóa luôn.
assertions: Stops and presents options: delete vs implement vs defer
Does NOT record the deletion until the user picks
Does NOT silently decide a load-bearing call

test_cases.name: never_touches_code_or_tests
test_cases.input: Test pin đang sai so với hành vi mới, sửa test cho khớp luôn nhé
assertions: Does NOT edit apps/, *.test.*, DESIGN.md, PRODUCT.md, or config
Says test changes go through test gates

test_cases.name: design_drift_from_implement
test_cases.input: /implement chặn vì slot header trong ## Design không khớp, patch spec
assertions: Treats ## Design as spec content, not UI-only drift
Takes the drift from the user's description since there is no apps/ diff
Patches ## Design as a MODIFIED hunk only after user confirm
Points back to /implement, NOT /verify

test_cases.name: stops_after_accept_with_pointer
test_cases.input: User đã accept patch của spec. Tiếp theo?
assertions: Points the next step as guidance only (architecture → /adr new number, otherwise /verify)
Does NOT run the next gate itself

test_cases.name: design_patch_on_old_spec_adds_thesis_and_sketch
test_cases.input: /backsync (UI spec approved before Thesis/Sketch existed; /implement blocked on a ## Design deviation)
assertions: Patches ## Design as MODIFIED hunks after the user confirms
Also adds the Thesis and Sketch slots because the spec has none
Follows the Design contract at the end of .agents/.commands/spec.md
Points back to /implement, not /verify
